description: Everything one wallet holds across Mamo: every Account it owns with balance, lifetime earnings, unclaimed rewards, APY and status, plus USD totals — and a stocks portfolio's NAV, cash, positions and fee due. Loose tokens and approvals: `get_wallet_balances`. A wallet with none returns an empty list. `verbose: true` adds raw figures and addresses.

address.description: The wallet address to look up, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

fresh.description: Bypass the cache; only right after a confirmed transaction.

verbose.description: Include the raw indexer figures behind each Account.

name: get_user_accounts
title: List a wallet's Mamo Accounts
